title: Deliver Copper Ore to Kinnton Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Copper Ore** delivered to **Kinnton Factory** (industry id 41, near tile 116,225).

A likely supplier is **Kinnton Copper Ore Mine** (industry id 13, near tile 136,230); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **320 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
